answer: Validators run a latency prism: twelve regional nodes ping each agent at random moments and split its round-trip times into a timing spectrum. Agents whose spectra overlap share one hosting footprint, so the n-th identity in that footprint must lock a bond of n squared times the base. A clone claiming a distant city tells a fable the timings expose. Escaping means renting real servers in new regions, so the bill climbs toward its zenith with every identity.
